body: Reaction pill is unioned into ChatListCell.bubbleSnapshotView's captureRect, so it renders inside the context menu's bubble snapshot. ChatContextMenuOverlay.gestureRecognizerShouldBegin vetoes every tap inside bubbleSnapshot.frame, which made the pill untappable. Fix: openContextMenu passes the strip rect in SNAPSHOT coords (layoutMenus shifts the bubble in Y and animateIn transforms it, so window coords are wrong) and pointHitsBubbleReaction tests it before the bubble veto.
